DevTools: styles, computed and box
model

Browser developer tools reveal matched rules, winning computed values, dimensions and layout
information.
Inspect Element වලින් HTML element එක Jතතෝරන්න. Styles tab එJකේ matched rules බලන්න.
Crossed-out declarations පෙරදින rules Jහතෝ Jවනතේ Jහේතුවකින් apply Jනාවන rules Jවන්න පුළුවන්.
Computed tab එJකේ final values සහ box model එක බලන්න.
Debug why a card is wider than the width declared in CSS.
Styles | Computed · width: 200px padding: 20px border: 2px · Card preview · border-box width = 244px

Read the diagram: 1. Inspect card. 2. Compare matched and computed width. 3. Read padding and
border. 4. Toggle box-sizing and measure again.
DevTools panel එJකේ width, padding සහ border බලලා actual border-box width එක හඳුනාගන්න.

Expected result: With content-box, outer border width is 244px. Switching to border-box gives
200px.
Interview question: How do you debug a CSS rule that is not applying?

Answer: Inspect the element, check matching selectors, invalid values and cascade priority, then
verify computed style.
Remember: Inspect → Styles → Computed → Box model.
Practice: Use DevTools to find the winning color of a button.
